rules.label: Identity 1
rules.text: The atom MUST identify a reaction by the reaction's triple.

rules.label: Identity 2
rules.text: The atom MUST NOT normalize a person reference.

rules.label: Identity 3
rules.text: The atom MUST compare two person references codepoint for codepoint.

rules.label: Identity 4
rules.text: The atom MUST NOT normalize an item reference.

rules.label: Identity 5
rules.text: The atom MUST compare two item references codepoint for codepoint.

rules.label: Identity 6
rules.text: The atom MUST NOT normalize a reaction name.

rules.label: Identity 7
rules.text: The atom MUST compare two reaction names codepoint for codepoint.

rules.label: State 1
rules.text: EVERY reaction MUST carry person reference, item reference, reaction name, first reacted instant and status.

rules.label: State 2
rules.text: EVERY reaction MUST stand in EXACTLY ONE OF held, withdrawn.

rules.label: State 3
rules.text: The atom MUST NOT remove a reaction.

rules.label: Capability requirement 1
rules.text: The deployment MUST supply the database PER Execution Contract Database 1 through 7, Execution Contract Read 1 through 6, Execution Contract Refusal 1, Execution Contract Input 1 and Execution Contract Query 5.

rules.label: Capability requirement 2
rules.text: The deployment MUST supply now at the seam PER Execution Contract Logic confinement 11.

rules.label: Capability requirement 3
rules.text: The deployment MAY declare the string cap PER Execution Contract Input 2 and Execution Contract Logic confinement 17.

rules.label: Capability requirement 4
rules.text: The deployment MUST NOT normalize a person reference at the seam.

rules.label: Capability requirement 5
rules.text: The deployment MUST NOT normalize an item reference at the seam.

rules.label: Capability requirement 6
rules.text: The deployment MUST NOT normalize a reaction name at the seam.

rules.label: Capability requirement 7
rules.text: The deployment MAY declare the reaction set PER Execution Contract Logic confinement 17.

rules.label: Capability requirement 8
rules.text: The deployment MAY declare the holding rule PER Execution Contract Logic confinement 17.

rules.label: Capability requirement 9
rules.text: IF a member of the reaction set EQUALS blank OR a member of the reaction set EXCEEDS the string cap THEN the deployment MUST NOT declare the reaction set.

rules.label: Operation 1
rules.text: IF the person reference EQUALS blank OR the person reference EXCEEDS the string cap THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-person-reference.

rules.label: Operation 2
rules.text: IF the item reference EQUALS blank OR the item reference EXCEEDS the string cap THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-item-reference.

rules.label: Operation 3
rules.text: IF the reaction name EQUALS blank OR the reaction name EXCEEDS the string cap THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-reaction-name.

rules.label: Operation 4
rules.text: IF no member of the reaction set EQUALS the reaction name THEN [React] MUST answer invalid-reaction-name.

rules.label: Operation 5
rules.text: IF no reaction EXISTS for the triple THEN [React] MUST record EXACTLY ONE reaction carrying the triple of the call.

rules.label: Operation 6
rules.text: IF no reaction EXISTS for the triple THEN [React] MUST stamp first reacted instant from the injected now.

rules.label: Operation 7
rules.text: IF no reaction EXISTS for the triple THEN [React] MUST stand the reaction in held.

rules.label: Operation 8
rules.text: IF the reaction's status EQUALS withdrawn THEN [React] MUST stand the reaction in held.

rules.label: Operation 9
rules.text: IF the reaction's status EQUALS held THEN [React] MUST NOT change the reaction.

rules.label: Operation 10
rules.text: IF the holding rule EQUALS one-per-item THEN [React] MUST stand EVERY rival in withdrawn.

rules.label: Operation 11
rules.text: IF the holding rule EQUALS one-of-each THEN [React] MUST NOT change a rival.

rules.label: Operation 12
rules.text: [React] MUST answer ok.

rules.label: Operation 13
rules.text: IF the reaction's status EQUALS held THEN [Withdraw] MUST stand the reaction in withdrawn.

rules.label: Operation 14
rules.text: IF the reaction's status EQUALS withdrawn THEN [Withdraw] MUST NOT write.

rules.label: Operation 15
rules.text: IF no reaction EXISTS for the triple THEN [Withdraw] MUST NOT write.

rules.label: Operation 16
rules.text: [Withdraw] MUST answer ok.

rules.label: Operation 17
rules.text: [Look Up] MUST answer the reaction name of EVERY held reaction carrying the pair.

rules.label: Operation 18
rules.text: [Look Up] MUST answer an empty list for a pair no held reaction carries.

rules.label: Operation 19
rules.text: [Look Up] MUST NOT write.

rules.label: Operation 20
rules.text: [Count] MUST answer the tally of EVERY reaction name a held reaction carrying the item reference carries.

rules.label: Operation 21
rules.text: [Count] MUST answer an empty list for an item reference no held reaction carries.

rules.label: Operation 22
rules.text: [Count] MUST NOT write.

rules.label: Operation 23
rules.text: IF the person reference is malformed THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-person-reference (Execution Contract Input 1).

rules.label: Operation 24
rules.text: IF the item reference is malformed THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-item-reference (Execution Contract Input 1).

rules.label: Operation 25
rules.text: IF the reaction name is malformed THEN a writing action MUST answer invalid-reaction-name (Execution Contract Input 1).

rules.label: Operation 26
rules.text: IF the person reference is malformed OR the person reference EQUALS blank OR the person reference EXCEEDS the string cap THEN [Look Up] MUST answer an empty list (Execution Contract Query 5).

rules.label: Operation 27
rules.text: IF the item reference is malformed OR the item reference EQUALS blank OR the item reference EXCEEDS the string cap THEN [Look Up] MUST answer an empty list (Execution Contract Query 5).

rules.label: Operation 28
rules.text: IF the item reference is malformed OR the item reference EQUALS blank OR the item reference EXCEEDS the string cap THEN [Count] MUST answer an empty list (Execution Contract Query 5).

rules.label: Operation 29
rules.text: [Look Up] MUST answer reaction names in codepoint order (Execution Contract Read 5, Execution Contract Logic confinement 10).

rules.label: Operation 30
rules.text: [Count] MUST answer tallies in codepoint order of reaction name (Execution Contract Read 5, Execution Contract Logic confinement 10).

rules.label: Check 1.2

summary: Reaction lets a person answer an item with one word from a short list the business offers: "Like" on a post, "Thanks" on an answer, or a small set such as Like, Love and Angry. Choosing a reaction holds it; where a person may hold one in all, choosing a different one replaces the first; taking a reaction back leaves the item as if the person had never reacted. Everyone can see how many people hold each reaction on an item. The business makes two choices. The first is the list of reactions, from a single Like to a handful. The second is how many a person may hold on one item: one in all, as on Facebook, or one of each, as on Slack and GitHub. The same request arriving twice changes nothing the second time, unless another request on the same item landed between them. A reaction says the item drew a person's attention, an angry one included; it is not approval, not a vote and not a saved item. Who may react, what the item is, telling the item's author, and any score built from the counts each belong to another pattern — another separately specified building block of the same kind — which is why one reaction serves a forum, a shop's reviews and a team chat alike.

term_entries.name: React
term_entries.text: Holds a reaction for a person on an item: records the [Reaction] where the triple has none, stamping its [First Reacted Instant], or stands a [Withdrawn] reaction back in [Held]. A reaction already held is left as it is. Under the [Holding Rule] one-per-item it also stands the person's other held reactions on the item in withdrawn. Answers ok.

term_entries.name: Withdraw
term_entries.text: Takes a reaction back: stands a [Held] reaction in [Withdrawn] and removes nothing. A reaction already withdrawn, or a triple with no reaction, is left as it is. Answers ok.

term_entries.name: Look Up
term_entries.text: Answers the [Reaction Name] of every reaction one person holds on one item now, and changes nothing; an empty list where the person holds none.

term_entries.name: Count
term_entries.text: Answers, for one item, each [Reaction Name] held on it with its [Tally], and changes nothing; an empty list where the item has no held reaction.

term_entries.name: Reaction
term_entries.text: One person's answer to one item in one reaction name: recorded by the first [React], stood in [Withdrawn] by [Withdraw] or by a replacing [React], and back in [Held] by [React]; never removed by the atom.

term_entries.name: Person Reference
term_entries.text: Names the person a reaction belongs to, in the deployment's own scheme. Stored as supplied and compared codepoint for codepoint; the atom reads no scheme in it, and whether the caller is that person is the composing pattern's question.

term_entries.name: Item Reference
term_entries.text: Names the item a reaction answers, in the deployment's own scheme. Stored as supplied and compared codepoint for codepoint; the atom reads no scheme in it, and whether it names a real item is a catalog's question.

term_entries.name: Reaction Name
term_entries.text: The string naming which reaction the person chose, one of the reaction set the deployment offered when the reaction was recorded, such as like. Stored as supplied and compared codepoint for codepoint; how it is drawn is the page's.

term_entries.name: First Reacted Instant
term_entries.text: The instant of the [React] call that recorded the reaction, stamped from the injected now; never changed, so a reaction withdrawn and held again keeps it.

term_entries.name: Held
term_entries.text: The status of a reaction the person keeps on the item; it is counted in the item's [Tally] for its reaction name.

term_entries.name: Withdrawn
term_entries.text: The status of a reaction the person took back or replaced; it is counted in no tally.

term_entries.name: Holding Rule
term_entries.text: The deployment's setting for how many reactions a person may hold on one item: one in all (one-per-item, the rule where none is declared) or one in each reaction name (one-of-each).

term_entries.name: Tally
term_entries.text: The number of held reactions carrying one item reference and one reaction name, as [Count] answers it.

term_entries.name: Invalid Person Reference
term_entries.text: The refusal of a blank [Person Reference], one over the string cap, or one that is not a string, on [React] or [Withdraw] (Operation 1, Operation 23).

term_entries.name: Invalid Item Reference
term_entries.text: The refusal of a blank [Item Reference], one over the string cap, or one that is not a string, on [React] or [Withdraw] (Operation 2, Operation 24).

term_entries.name: Invalid Reaction Name
term_entries.text: The refusal of a blank [Reaction Name], one over the string cap, or one that is not a string, on [React] or [Withdraw], and of a name the reaction set does not offer on [React] (Operation 3, Operation 4, Operation 25).

term_entries.name: Storage Failure
term_entries.text: The refusal [React] or [Withdraw] answers when the database refuses its write after every precondition passes: the Execution Contract's Step 3 failure.
